holes_found.description: PROSE AMBIGUITY in patched sentence — "the dome’s identification of this inter-harmonic minimum" admits two readings. Reading 1: the dome correctly identifies the inter-harmonic minimum (which contradicts the earlier text saying the dome calls it a "prominent peak"). Reading 2: the dome’s act of singling out this 11.78 Hz region (which the dome misidentifies as a peak) is itself the standard-physics prediction. The intended reading is (2). A dome-defender quote-mining could highlight reading (1) as a concession ("your own text agrees the dome got the identification right"). WIN-008 detail_evidence has the same parallel construction ("The inter-harmonic minimum the dome identifies") and survives reader comprehension in 5 prior cycles without flagging — so this is a low-severity polish item, not a blocker. The earlier sentence in the same paragraph ("This is not a ‘prominent peak’ — it is an inter-harmonic power minimum...") supplies the disambiguating frame. Defender attack rating: 2/5.
holes_found.recommendation: Optional minor edit: tighten phrasing to e.g. "Like WIN-008, what the dome flags as evidence — the 11.78 Hz region — is itself a prediction of standard spherical-cavity physics (which predicts a power minimum between the 7.83 Hz and 14.3 Hz Schumann modes), making this another instance of relabeling a globe-model prediction as dome evidence." Low priority; the cross-paragraph context disambiguates. Decider may file as a polish-tier ISS or wontfix.

holes_found.description: PATCH-INTENT DRIFT — the H3 hole in WIN-008.c5 (which drove ISS-2785) recommended adding an inline "f = c/(2D) parasitism" note quoting the polar-diameter substitution. The applied patch (EXP-638) substituted a relabels_standard sentence instead. The two arguments are distinct: parasitism = "the dome’s formula silently uses Earth’s polar diameter"; relabeling = "the dome restates a known standard-physics feature as its own evidence." Both are valid critiques but answer different reader objections. A reader landing on WIN-009 standalone still has to click through to WIN-008 to see the quantitative parasitism (f = c/(2D), D = 12,717 km matches polar diameter to 0.03%). H3 itself rated this "low priority because the cross-link is present" and "polish item, not a hole a defender can exploit," so the substitution is defensible — but the c8 review should disclose that the H3 intent was not literally satisfied, only adjacently addressed.
holes_found.recommendation: No action required (H3 explicitly accepted the cross-link as adequate). If the operator/decider wants tighter parallelism with WIN-008, a future patch could add a one-clause parasitism note (e.g., "; see WIN-008 for the f = c/(2D) silently-uses-Earth’s-diameter parasitism") to make WIN-009 self-contained.

kernel_of_truth.description: Unchanged from c7 — the dome correctly identifies the ~11–12 Hz region as physically distinctive (data/wins.json:WIN-009.detail_evidence). It is distinctive: it sits between the Schumann fundamental and first harmonic, exactly where standard spherical-cavity theory predicts a power minimum (Chave & Jones 2012 cited inline, DOI HTTP 200 verified). The c8 patch makes this kernel-of-truth more explicit by stating the relabeling structure inline.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: The dome inverts a minimum to a peak (data/wins.json:WIN-009.detail_claim says "prominent ~12 Hz peak"; data/wins.json:WIN-009.detail_evidence shows the standard-cavity model predicts a minimum there). The 14.3 Hz first Schumann harmonic falsifies any "resonance ceiling" claim, and the f = c/(2D) match only works when D = Earth’s polar diameter (cross-linked via WIN-008). The c8 patch reinforces this by making the relabels_standard argument explicit inline.

deeper_analysis: Advocate-mode (Lens A): three defender attacks on the patched text. (1) PROSE AMBIGUITY ("the dome’s identification of this inter-harmonic minimum" reads as if the dome got the identification right). Rating 2/5 — the cross-paragraph frame disambiguates and the parallel WIN-008 construction has survived 5 prior cycles. (2) NOT THE H3-RECOMMENDED PATCH (the applied sentence is relabels_standard, not the H3-recommended parasitism note). Rating 2/5 — H3 was explicitly low-priority polish and accepted the cross-link as adequate. (3) "LIKE WIN-008" presumes reader has read WIN-008. Rating 1/5 — the sentence is self-contained even without the WIN-008 comparison; the "Like WIN-008" is a hint, not a load-bearing clause. None of the defender attacks rate 3+; no preemptive text change required. Cross-WIN consistency (Lens B): WIN-008.detail_evidence carries the parallel sentence ("The inter-harmonic minimum the dome identifies is itself a prediction of standard spherical-cavity physics — it is another instance of relabeling globe predictions as dome evidence."); WIN-009 c8 patch is structurally parallel. WIN-029 (Schumann cavity, Self-Contradicted) cross-references the same loss-corrected progression (Sentman 1990, Mushtak & Williams 2002). All three WINs assume measured Schumann harmonics 7.83/14.3/20.8/27.3/33.8 Hz with loss-corrected spherical-cavity origins — consistent. Quantitative verification (Lens C): re-computed lossless eigenfrequencies f_n = c·sqrt(n(n+1))/(2πR) for R=6371 km: 10.59/18.34/25.94/33.49/41.02 Hz; measured/lossless ratios 0.74/0.78/0.80/0.82/0.82 — the canonical ~25% loss correction (Sentman 1990) reproduces measured values, confirming the "follow the spherical Earth–ionosphere cavity progression" claim is technically accurate. f = c/(2D) reverse for 11.787: D = 12,717.1 km, -0.027% off Earth’s polar diameter (12,713.6 km) — matches WIN-008/WIN-009 claim. Dome-native: firmament 9,086 km → 16.50 Hz; disc radius 20,015 km → 7.49 Hz — neither matches 11.787 Hz.

advocate_mode.best_defense: The strongest defender rebuttal to WIN-009 c8: "Your patched sentence is grammatically ambiguous — ‘the dome’s identification of this inter-harmonic minimum’ reads as if you agree the dome identified a minimum. So either (a) the dome correctly identified a minimum and your patch concedes that kernel-of-truth is far stronger than your other text claims, or (b) the dome misidentified it as a peak and your new sentence is incoherent." Stepping out of character: the cross-paragraph context disambiguates (Reading 2 is intended and supported by the prior text saying "this is not a prominent peak — it is an inter-harmonic minimum"). The parallel WIN-008 construction has survived 5 prior cycles without being flagged. Real but minor.
